reviews.title: Great organizer and tracker.
reviews.text: Im a huge advocate for checking progress to improve and stay efficient. Sometimes I feel like I have been super consistent and when I think about it I haven’t really. This gives me certainty about the exact amount of consistency I’ve done as long as I remember to put it in the app. The widget makes it easy to see without even leaving my Home Screen. I would ask for a ways to translate a year or months work of stats into one big graph document, it would just be a personal plus.

reviews.title: Key feature missing
reviews.text: The app is a great way to track your habits. However, there is no way to tick off completed habits of the previous day. This is especially useful when you’re new habit is about quitting and old habit.

reviews.title: Update suggestions to improve.
reviews.text: It would be nice if when you change your start date, it’s reflected in all areas of the app including widgets. It would also be nice if you could add a small note to a certain date. For example if I didn’t do a task, being able to put why. Or if I did do a task, writing something about it.

reviews.title: Awesome! Finally found something that works for me!
reviews.text: I love this app! Found it on Reddit and saw the developer was offering the lifetime subscription for free. So I jumped on it and I’m so glad I did! It’s nice and simple, easy to create habits and even habits you want to break. Good analytics and all the features I was looking for. I also love the little quotes at the top of the home page. I do wish there was a way to have habits that need to be done multiple times a day. Currently, you can only add multiple times and alerts, but it marks it complete as soon as you do it once. It’d also be great to have a vacation mode so you don’t loose your streaks. Overall, I love this app and it works great for me. Simple aesthetic and has all the functionality I need. I really strive on checking habits and watching my streak grow, so thank you for making this app!

reviews.title: Analytics lacking
reviews.text: I tried this primarily for the analytics to help evaluate what impact my habits might have on a particular health problem. I find the charts to be extremely basic and you can’t see all your habits charted at once. I like how it works to set up the habit and tracking it is visually appealing and easy. I’m just not finding nearly enough features. I would love a line chart showing all habits at once.

reviews.title: Does it’s job and looks clean
reviews.text: Simple and elegant. Does everything it needs to do.

reviews.title: Bait & Switch
reviews.text: This app is absolute dog water if you’re not willing to pay for it. Limits you to five habits and none of the widgets (which are functional when you first install the app) work. Not one of them. Not only that but the widgets themselves and the app would sometimes stop letting me tick off a habit and I’d have to restart the app to get it working again. I can’t wrap my head around an app this basic not even working properly and then having the stones to pull the rug out from under me if I don’t go through with a recurring subscription. To track some habits locally on my phone… yeah, ok.

reviews.title: Really Nice App
reviews.text: I really love this app. It has so many nice features. Besides the obvious habit tracking, it asks you who you would like to become by doing this habit and I found that to be very profound, helpful and motivating. I also love the quotes and the reminders. Overall would highly recommend this app.

reviews.title: App Is Great
reviews.text: The apps UI is very good looking and the functionality. Just some recommendations. For one, when you make a habit and put in what you want to become, you can put capital letters but it doesn’t display in the app or notification. It would be nice if you are able to out capital words so they can display on notifications. Also on the notification, I feel like it would look better without the quotation marks.
